For a column of saltwater with a density of 1025 kg/m ³ that is 10 m high with a gravity of 9.81 m/s ² , 
using (p1) we get: δP = (1025)(9.81)(10) ~ 10 ⁵ Pa, which is the pressure at the bottom of the atmosphere. Thus, the weight of the entire atmosphere is equivalent to 10 m of seawater!
